WITH award_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.throws, 'missing') as throws,
    COUNT(*) as tally
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, 'missing')
),
total_awards AS (
  SELECT SUM(tally) as total FROM award_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.throws,
    ac.tally,
    ac.tally * 1.0 / t.total as share
  FROM award_counts ac
  CROSS JOIN total_awards t
),
avg_share_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    s.throws,
    s.tally,
    s.share,
    asv.avg_share
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_val asv
  WHERE s.share > asv.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(tally) as combined_tally,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as above_average
FROM above_avg
